Outside risk外部风险 What could hit from abroad外部可能的冲击
Pressure coming from outside China — US interest rates, the yuan, the gap between US and Chinese yields, and how many stocks are joining in. It sets the backdrop for how big to trade. It never removes a name and never changes the board's order.来自中国以外的压力 — 美国利率、人民币汇率、中美利差，以及有多少个股在参与。它决定该用多大仓位，但绝不剔除任何标的，也不改变看板排序。

Theme cycles主题周期

?Each theme is a curated basket of A-shares with its own turn model, and the rail shows where that basket sits in its cycle. Every member is then placed in exactly one column, so a row adds up to the whole basket; a name counts once, at its most actionable state, and a name can sit in more than one theme. The cycle read is a place to look, not a measured edge — no horizon of it has cleared a significance bar. Nothing on this panel ranks, gates or sizes anything, and the board above is identical with it present or absent.每个主题都是一篮精选A股，各自带有转向模型，刻度条显示该篮子在周期中的位置。每只成分股被归入且仅归入一列，因此整行相加等于该篮子全部成分股；同一只股票按其最可操作的状态计入一次，且可能同时属于多个主题。周期研判只用于确定观察方向，并非经检验的优势——尚无周期通过显著性检验。本面板不参与任何排名、筛选或仓位决定，上方看板有无本面板都完全相同。 as of 2026-09-30截至 2026-09-30
